name: zora_fountain
label: Zora's Fountain
about: Pieces and textures cut from Zora's Fountain (spot08). Definitions only: the meshes come from the extract (ROM data) into out/. Coordinates are the builder's: x east, y north, z up (glTF's (x, -z, y)). See ADR 0036.

textures.about: Material N -> role (2026-10-09, from the textures and where Zora's Fountain draws them). `cliff` is the wide band of rock round the fountain, `cliff_b` the big blocky rock of its upper walls, `rock` the streaked rock of the east ledge, `ground_rock` the cobbled ground by the Ice Cavern, `ceiling` an overhang's underside. `water` (and `water_b`) is the fountain's surface, `lakebed` and `lakebed_wall` the floor and walls seen through it (no detail textures anywhere). `altar_tiles`, `altar_pillar`, `altar_trim` and `balustrade` build Jabu-Jabu's altar; `log_bark`, `log_bark_b` and `log_end` the dead trees; `pole` the stake fence; `vines` the climbable strip. `forest_trunks`, `forest_foliage` and `foliage_edge` are the forest cards beyond the walls, `backdrop` the skyline, `shadow` the darkness in cave mouths, `foam` the outflow's foam.

surfaces.about: Surface type -> collision role (oot_import::level::ROLES), where the default read off the type (kit::default_role) is wrong.

pieces.name: zf_jabu_altar
pieces.label: Jabu-Jabu's altar
pieces.about: The stone platform where Jabu-Jabu lies (an actor): a slab 400 by 560 standing 292 above the pool's floor with its top 32 above the water, with a ramp up out of the water on its west side, balustrades, and four carved pillars at its corners (the west pair 352 tall). Its east edge's floor is exit 2 (into Jabu-Jabu's belly, ENTR_BDAN_0), where his mouth was.

pieces.name: zf_pillar
pieces.label: Carved pillar
pieces.about: A square pillar of carved stone, 80 across and 352 tall, with a flat cap Link can stand on; from the corners of Jabu-Jabu's altar. Its sides don't let Link grab them.

pieces.name: zf_balustrade
pieces.label: Balustrade
pieces.about: A stone balustrade 260 long and 48 high (one baluster every 20), from the sides of Jabu-Jabu's altar. Cut out; its top rail collides as a floor.

pieces.name: zf_sunken_tree
pieces.label: Sunken tree
pieces.about: A dead tree fallen into the fountain, its trunk sloping 450 up out of the water and three bare limbs reaching down; Link can walk up it (wood).

pieces.name: zf_dead_tree
pieces.label: Dead tree
pieces.about: A bare dead tree 920 tall with a crown of thin branches, standing in the fountain's south shallows (one of two; the other is much the same).

pieces.name: zf_stake_fence
pieces.label: Stake fence
pieces.about: A row of sharpened stakes 942 long and 200 high (one every 36), cut out on one card; it fenced off the fountain's outflow on the west. It collides as a wood wall.

pieces.name: zf_vines
pieces.label: Vine wall
pieces.about: A climbable strip of vines 120 wide and 810 tall up the east cliff to the high ledge. Placed on a wall's face.
